environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large) running identical code. Instance sits behind an ALB with a listener rule that injects response headers via a Lambda@Edge-equivalent mechanism (ALB fixed-response action on health check, plus a custom response header policy attached to the target group's stickiness configuration). The critical control: an nginx reverse proxy sidecar (running as a systemd unit on the same instance) is configured with proxy_pass to localhost:3000 and adds 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; script-src self; style-src self unsafe-inline; object-src none; base-uri self' to ALL responses. Additionally, nginx is configured with limit_req zone=api burst=2 nodelay on location /api/withdraw, creating a per-IP request queue that serializes concurrent withdrawal requests through a 1r/s rate with burst of 2. The pm2 process runs in fork mode (single instance) rather than cluster mode, eliminating shared-nothing race conditions across workers. The combination of serialized request processing via nginx rate limiting AND single-process execution eliminates the TOCTOU race window.
